title: Railway fleet shortage threatens train operations: Station Masters' Association
summary: The Sri Lanka Railway Station Masters' Association (SLRSMU) has warned that train operations could be at risk due to the declining number of operational locomotives and power sets.
description: The Sri Lanka Railway Station Masters' Association (SLRSMU) has warned that train operations could be at risk due to the declining number of operational locomotives and power sets.

title: Amber advisory issued for strong winds in several areas
summary: The Department of Meteorology has issued an Amber advisory for strong winds affecting the Northern, North-Central and North-Western provinces, as well as the Matale, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.

title: Sanjeewa Rodrigo appointed to vacant Kotte Municipal Council seat
summary: Sanjeewa Rodrigo has been appointed to fill the vacant Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte Municipal Council seat held by the Samagi Jana Balawegaya.

title: Jaffna Kings co-owner and another Indian national remanded
summary: Two Indian nationals, including a co-owner of the Jaffna Kings franchise in the Lanka Premier League, have been remanded until 31 July over alleged attempts to influence players to engage in match-fixing.

title: SIS shared list of 129 ISIS-linked individuals with CID before Easter attacks, court told
summary: President’s Counsel Sanjeewa Jayawardena told the Court of Appeal that the State Intelligence Service had shared a list of 129 individuals, including Easter Sunday bomber Zahran Hashim, with the CID in January 2019.
